text: HDFC Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Director(s) of the company.
nse_summary: HDFC Bank Limited has approved the re-appointment of Mr. V. Srinivasa Rangan, DIN 00030248, as Whole-time Director designated as Executive Director for a period of one year effective from November 23, 2026. This approval follows recommendations from the Governance, Nomination and Remuneration Committee and consent from the Reserve Bank of India. The re-appointment is subject to shareholder approval. Mr. Rangan will continue at extant remuneration. He is not related to any other Director or Key Managerial Personnel of the Bank and is not debarred from holding office. The bank will seek shareholder approval for this re-appointment.
